cards.title: Seven Different Local Phone Numbers
cards.body: The website lists 707-532-2052 (Sales), 707-353-4579 (Service) and 707-475-0868 (Parts). Google lists (707) 926-3135 for the dealership and (707) 348-0555 for the shared Service & Parts listing; Bing repeats the first. Facebook lists (707) 452-2500 and the Mitsubishi dealer locator lists 707-513-4935. Apple Maps and Yelp match the website’s Sales number. Some may be call-tracking numbers (not verified). AI engines and directories draw on this data, so conflicting numbers weaken confidence.

cards.title: Service & Parts Share One Thin, AI-Indexable Entity
cards.body: Google Maps shows one “Vacaville Mitsubishi Service and Parts” listing nested under the main listing: 1 category, 1 review (5.0★, four months old, unanswered), no description and no scheduling link, with its own website and phone number. Whether a query like “Mitsubishi service Vacaville” on ChatGPT or Perplexity currently returns Vacaville Mitsubishi was not directly tested.

cards.title: Strong Reviews, Invisible on the Website
cards.body: Google shows 4.9★ across 172 reviews, but none appear on the rendered homepage or Contact Us page, and the site has no reviews page. Facebook shows no star rating or recommendation figure, and Yelp shows 3.3★ across 7 reviews.

cards.title: sameAs Lists Only the Google Profile
cards.body: The AutoDealer schema’s sameAs list holds the Google Business Profile link and nothing else — no Facebook, Instagram, Yelp or other official profiles — and no hasMap or map property appears on any page checked. (Effect on entity recognition inferred, not tested.)

CLIKsearch’s omni-social distribution across 6 platforms creates continuous cross-platform entity citations that multiply this authority signal for AI engine indexing.

cards.title: Seven Different Local Phone Numbers
cards.body: Website: 707-532-2052 (Sales), 707-353-4579 (Service), 707-475-0868 (Parts); the Parts schema entity repeats 707-532-2052. Google: (707) 926-3135 for the dealership and (707) 348-0555 for the shared Service & Parts listing. Bing: (707) 926-3135. Facebook: (707) 452-2500. Mitsubishi dealer locator: 707-513-4935. Apple Maps and Yelp show 707-532-2052 and match. Name, address, and phone should match everywhere the business is listed; some of these may be call-tracking numbers (not verified). Of the five directories sampled (Apple Maps, Bing, Yelp, Facebook, the locator) two agree with the website. Audit Verified · October 20, 2026

cards.title: Mitsubishi Dealer Locator Shows Different Service Hours
cards.body: The Mitsubishi locator lists Service hours of 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM Monday to Friday; the website and Google show 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (checked October 20, 2026). Sales hours (9:00 AM to 8:00 PM) agree everywhere.

cards.title: Service & Parts Share One Thin Google Listing
cards.body: Google has a single “Vacaville Mitsubishi Service and Parts” listing at Suite A, nested under the main listing. It has 1 category (Auto repair shop), 1 review (5.0★, four months old, no reply), no description and no scheduling link; its phone is (707) 348-0555 and its website is factorypartsstore.com. The website lists separate Service and Parts numbers. Both views: the website’s schema already describes Service (AutoRepair) and Parts (AutoPartsStore) departments (audited October 20, 2026) — neither entity links to the combined Google listing, and Google shows no separate Service or Parts listings.
cards.pill: CLIKsearch — Service & Parts Profile Setup & Management

cards.title: Google Reviews Aren’t Shown on the Website
cards.body: None of the dealership’s 172 Google reviews (4.9★) appear on its homepage or its Contact Us page, and no Reviews or Testimonials page was found in the navigation, footer or site map — checked in a browser on October 20, 2026. Visitors have to leave the website to see the reputation that lives on the Google Business Profile. Reviews can be shown visibly to visitors — for example a Google reviews widget or testimonials — without any review markup in the structured data.

cards.title: Posting Below the Standard on Service & Parts and Sales
cards.body: The Sales profile posted 5 times in the 30 days before the audit (newest 16 hours earlier) against a standard of 8 a month. The shared Service & Parts listing posted once (October 6, 2026) against a standard of 4, and its owner-uploaded photos date to April 2026. The posting standard is one we set, not a Google requirement. (Competitor posting activity in Vacaville, CA not directly audited — industry pattern.)
cards.pill: CLIKsearch — Weekly SEO/GEO Content & Photo Posts

cards.title: No Logo Seen on Either Google Listing
cards.body: Both listings show a cover photo, but no business logo was seen; the profile image on the Sales and the shared listing is a photo or an initial (checked October 20, 2026). A logo is one of the two profile-image items scored.

cards.title: sameAs Lists Only the Google Profile; No hasMap or map
cards.body: The AutoDealer schema’s sameAs list contains the Google Business Profile link only — it does not include Facebook, Instagram, Yelp or the other official profiles. sameAs is how a site’s structured data points to a business’s other official profiles. No hasMap or legacy map property appears on the top-level entity or on the Service and Parts department entities (parsed from the JSON-LD on the homepage, About Us (Contact Us), Service, Parts, and Hours & Directions pages, October 20, 2026). (Effect on entity recognition inferred, not tested.)

cards.title: Department Entities Don’t Match the Listings
cards.body: The schema has Service (AutoRepair, 707-353-4579) and Parts (AutoPartsStore) entities with their own page addresses, but no separate Sales department entity, and the Parts entity repeats the main phone number while the page shows 707-475-0868. Neither department entity carries a sameAs or map link to the combined Google listing (audited October 20, 2026).

cards.title: Apple Maps Listing Is Unclaimed
cards.body: The Apple Maps listing for the dealership shows “Claim This Place” (checked October 20, 2026). Its name, address and phone match the website. Yelp shows a claimed page (3.3★, 7 reviews) with the matching phone.

why_card.title: Seven Phone Numbers = Split Calls and Mixed Signals
why_card.body: Customers and search engines see seven different local numbers for this dealership across the website, Google, Bing, Facebook and the Mitsubishi locator — so calls, directions and service requests can land in the wrong place, and every conflicting listing weakens the others. Competitors with one aligned number per department are positioned to compound their Map Pack advantage every single week.

tiles: Five Sales posts in the last 30 days against a standard of 8 a month; the shared Service & Parts listing has 1 against 4.
One Google listing covers both departments: 1 category, 1 review, no description or scheduling link.

locked: Entity Authority: sameAs Lists Only the Google Profile — Other Official Profiles Not Linked

sameAs is how a site’s structured data points to a business’s other official profiles. This dealership’s lists only the Google Business Profile — Facebook, Instagram, Yelp and the other official profiles aren’t among the linked profiles — so the site’s entity data is thinner than a fully built profile set.
Department Schema Out of Step: No Sales Entity, and the Parts Phone Repeats the Main Number

The site’s structured data describes Service and Parts departments, but has no separate Sales department entity, and the Parts entry repeats the main phone number while the page shows a different Parts number.
Service Hours Differ Between the Website and the Mitsubishi Locator
The Mitsubishi dealer locator lists Service hours of 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM, while the website and Google show 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM — one more place where the dealership’s facts do not line up.
